write: PUT of symbols/selections needs a lock on /sap/bc/adt/textelements/programs/{name} (a lock on the program URI answers 'Resource REPT … is not locked'), Content-Type application/vnd.sap.adt.textelements.<symbols|selections>.v1, ?lockHandle=. Texts land INACTIVE; activating the program URI alone leaves them inactive — activate /sap/bc/adt/textelements/programs/{name} (adtcore:type PROG/PX) to publish them. Same for /sap/bc/adt/textelements/classes/{name} (activate as CLAS/OCX; symbols only) and /sap/bc/adt/textelements/functiongroups/{name} (activate as FUGR/PX; symbols, selections, headings). The headings PUT uses Content-Type application/vnd.sap.adt.textelements.headings.v1 and replaces all five lines.
